info.headline: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Grand Central Parkway approaching Steinway Street (QN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-04-2026 at 05:40 AM.
Due to a police investigation, all eastbound lanes of the Grand Central Parkway are closed approaching Steinway Street in Queens. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnTjHH.
